profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MKS Instruments
profile.summary:
I have over 20 years of professional experience with Industrial Automation, focused on PLC programming and data acquisition. My hobbies reinforce this experience, with microcontroller and desktop programming work, along with digital communication protocols and circuits.

A sample of my automotive-related work is found at: https://www.instagram.com/2010lstti/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Programming Laser PCB drilling systems using C# on .NET Framework 4.8 under the Agile philosophy.

- C#, Winforms, WPF
- Unit tests using MSTest and Fakes
- Azure Devops pipelines
- Mostly targeting .NET 4.8
- Visual Studio 2022
- MVVM
- Team subject matter expert on Laser Beam Characterization and ISO 11146

positions.title: PLC Engineer
positions.description:
- PLC development using Siemens Step 7 and Siemens TIA software packages
- SCADA development using Kepware OPC server and Siemens WinCC
- Custom tools developed in C#

positions.title: Contractor / Software Engineer
positions.description:
- PLC development using Siemens, Mitsubishi, Allen-Bradley equipment
- Motion control development using Galil and Siemens equipment
- Embedded development on Atmel AVR, TI MSP430, and EFM32 MCUs
- Desktop development with C#, VB .NET, VB 6.0

positions.title: Controls Engineer
positions.description:
(520) 546-6313
* Design, program, test, deploy, and maintain software for machine control and HMI
interfaces on various types of factory production machines
* Design, program, and deploy data acquisition systems for factory production machines
* Support code for machines at Tucson and Berlin sites
* Write Excel utilities and macros to manipulate sets of data as needed

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
Network administrator for 45 node network (Windows NT 4.0/Windows 98)
* Set up network firewall, primary and secondary Domain servers, Exchange server, SQL
server
* Purchased computers, servers, and printers

positions.title: Applications Software Engineer
positions.description:
(540) 769-8200
* Design, program, test, deploy, and maintain software for Campus Support databases
* Wrote front-ends for campus databases in VB and ASP .NET used by 29 remote sites
* Maintained internet and intranet websites

positions.title: Network Administrator / Lab Technician
positions.description:
Network administrator for 30 node network (Windows NT 4.0/Windows 95)
* Designed and implemented company website
* Ran equipment in materials chemistry lab to create ultrafine spherical particles and
composite nanotubes
* Monitored machines and collected samples
* Machined and assembled fuel cell prototypes for military contracts

projects.title: Ethereum Mining System
projects.description: Built, configured, and deployed an 8 node, 70+ GPU Ethereum mining system running on Linux for personal use. One node is oiled cooled using a custom system.

projects.title: High Speed Electric Bicycle
projects.description: I have modified a Stromer ST1 bicycle with a 4 kW hub motor, a Cycle Analyst V2, and a custom made battery pack with cells sourced from a Tesla electric car. This involved welding, fabrication, soldering, and a little circuit design. The top speed of the 113VDC bicycle was 58.6 MPH.
